description: Use when asked "how much research is there on the thorax" or "which body parts have no studies yet". The Studies per body part key of the Greencyclepedia body map. Give a region (head-neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, upper-limb-left, upper-limb-right, lower-limb-left, lower-limb-right) or leave it out for the whole body: the parts by study band (No studies yet, 1 to 99, 100 to 999, 1,000+) with counts, the most studied parts, the parts with no studies yet, the snapshot date, the source and licence and the body map link. A count is the PubMed studies that name the part, from a weekly saved snapshot. Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"region":"thorax"}.

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 100.

region.description: A region id or name, for example "thorax", "head-neck" or "left leg", or "whole body". Leave out for the whole body.

name: studies_by_region
title: Studies per body part, by region
